headline: Your privacy. Your care. Our *commitment*.
lede: Premier Wellness Telehealth is committed to providing professional, secure, and transparent virtual healthcare. This page explains important information about privacy, telehealth services, payment, prescribing, emergency care, and use of this website.
intro: Please review the applicable policies before receiving care. Each policy below links to the complete document; this page is an overview, not the policy itself.
body:
## Privacy & Protected Health Information

{{ site.name }} respects the privacy of your health information and uses safeguards designed to protect information handled in connection with your care. Medical information should be submitted only through the secure systems and communication methods designated by the practice.

- Do not submit sensitive medical information through public website fields unless the form is specifically identified as a secure patient-care form.
- Clinical records, intake information, messages, and other protected health information are handled through the practice's approved healthcare technology and record systems.
- The Notice of Privacy Practices explains how protected health information may be used and disclosed and describes applicable patient rights.

[View Notice of Privacy Practices](/legal/hipaa/)

## Telehealth Services & Consent

{{ site.name }} provides virtual healthcare to eligible adult patients who are physically located in a state where the treating provider is authorized to practice at the time care is delivered. Telehealth may include scheduled video visits and, for selected conditions, asynchronous online visits.

- Telehealth is not appropriate for every medical concern.
- A provider may recommend an in-person examination, laboratory or diagnostic testing, specialist evaluation, urgent care, or emergency care when clinically appropriate.
- Patients may be required to verify their identity and physical location at the time of care.
- Online visits require completion of requested clinical information. Submission of a questionnaire does not guarantee treatment, a diagnosis, or a prescription.

## Self-Pay Services & Financial Responsibility

{{ site.name }} operates as a self-pay practice. Fees are displayed before booking, and patients are responsible for charges associated with the services they select.

- {{ site.name }} does not bill health insurance for routine self-pay services.
- Insurance coverage or reimbursement, if independently sought by a patient, is determined by the patient's health plan.
- Laboratory testing, imaging, pharmacy charges, medications, or outside services may involve separate fees unless specifically stated as included.
- {{ derived.cancellationPolicy }}

[View Pricing](/pricing/)

## Prescriptions & Medication Management

Medication may be prescribed, continued, adjusted, or declined based on the provider's clinical judgment, applicable law, patient safety, and the information available during the evaluation.

- An appointment or online visit does not guarantee that a medication will be prescribed.
- Some medications or medical conditions may require an in-person examination, laboratory monitoring, prior medical records, or specialty care.
- {{ site.name }} cannot guarantee pharmacy inventory, medication availability, insurance coverage, formulary approval, or pharmacy fulfillment.
- The practice does not prescribe medications that fall outside its clinical scope or prescribing policies. Controlled substances are not prescribed.

## Medical Weight Management

{{ site.name }} offers evidence-based medical management of overweight and obesity as one component of comprehensive adult healthcare. The practice is not a rapid-weight-loss or medication-dispensing clinic.

- Treatment is individualized and based on medical history, clinical assessment, treatment goals, risks, and appropriate monitoring.
- Prescription therapy, including GLP-1 or dual GIP/GLP-1 medications, may be considered when clinically appropriate.
- Booking a consultation does not guarantee eligibility for a particular medication.
- Medication availability, insurance coverage, prior authorization decisions, and pharmacy fulfillment are not guaranteed.

## Emergencies & Urgent Medical Needs

{% emergency %}
**Emergency notice**

{{ site.name }} does not provide emergency medical services. If you are experiencing a medical emergency or potentially life-threatening symptoms, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not use the website, patient portal, messaging system, or an online visit to seek emergency care.
{% endemergency %}

## Website Information & Medical Disclaimer

Information provided on this website is for general educational and informational purposes and is not a substitute for individualized medical evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment. Viewing the website, submitting a general inquiry, or reading educational content does not by itself establish a provider-patient relationship.

- Medical decisions should be based on an appropriate clinical evaluation.
- Do not delay seeking professional or emergency medical care because of information found on this website.
- Website content may be updated as clinical services, laws, technology, or practice policies change.

## Accessibility & Nondiscrimination

{{ site.name }} is committed to respectful and accessible care. If you need reasonable communication assistance, or have difficulty accessing website content or virtual-care services, please contact us and we will help.

[Contact Us for Assistance](mailto:{{ site.email }})

## Policies & Important Documents

Policies marked as in preparation are being drafted and reviewed before publication.

## Contact Information

Questions about these policies may be directed to {{ site.email }}. Office hours are {{ derived.hoursLong }}.
